Export to Gephi node and edge tables

Source: R/converters.R
to_gephi.Rd

to_gephi() converts a bibnets edge list (and optional node table) to the CSV format expected by Gephi's Data Laboratory. Column names are remapped to Gephi conventions (Source, Target, Weight, Id, Label).

Usage

to_gephi(edges, nodes = NULL, file = NULL, directed = FALSE)

Arguments

edges

A data frame with at least from, to, weight columns.

nodes

Optional data frame of node attributes. Must contain an id column. All other columns are included as Gephi node attributes.

file

Optional directory path. If supplied, writes nodes.csv and edges.csv into that directory. If NULL (default), returns a list.

directed

Logical. Sets the Type column. Default FALSE.

Value

If file = NULL, a list of two plain data frames: nodes (one row per node, columns Id, Label, then any extra node attributes) and edges (one row per edge, columns Source, Target, Weight, Type, then the remaining edge columns such as count). If file is an existing directory, writes nodes.csv and edges.csv there, reports the paths with a message, and returns the two paths invisibly.

Examples

data(biblio_data)
edges <- author_network(biblio_data, "collaboration")
to_gephi(head(edges, 3))
#> $nodes
#>        Id   Label
#> 1  CHEN W  CHEN W
#> 2 BROWN M BROWN M
#> 3   LEE K   LEE K
#> 4 SMITH J SMITH J
#> 
#> $edges
#>    Source  Target Weight       Type count
#> 1  CHEN W   LEE K      3 Undirected     3
#> 2 BROWN M SMITH J      3 Undirected     3
#> 3 BROWN M   LEE K      2 Undirected     2
#> 

# Write nodes.csv and edges.csv into a directory
out_dir <- tempfile("gephi")
dir.create(out_dir)
to_gephi(edges, file = out_dir)
#> Written: /tmp/Rtmpac1oe5/gephi1a21897ecbc/nodes.csv
#>         /tmp/Rtmpac1oe5/gephi1a21897ecbc/edges.csv
unlink(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
